task.summary: Default task
Added a simple game HUD and split the health variable to maxHealth and currentHealth.
simplified some condition statements.
Positions of both the player and the goal/dungeon exit is now determined by the generator.
Extended a new Player class from the GameCharacter class. Created draw functions inside the Enemy and Player classes.
Basic goal function. New dungeon generates when player steps into the goal.
Player class added
Redesigned attack move; attacking is now independent from positional movement controls.
Added the rock, paper, scissors elements for the game, including the color assignments.
Implemented the core combat mechanics of the game.
Added counters for the enemy types in the generator.
Added mutation function in the genetic algorithm.
Clears the array list for "dead enemies" every generation.
Added chips element to the player's class
Chips are now added to player on enemy kill
Added basic element switching mechanic involving the "chips" points.
Added game sprites. Implemented player sprite with the animator and the tiles in the game.
Updated the enemy class' behavioral trees (a.k.a. enemy game AI). Enemies can now chase the player within a certain radius.
Controller class is no InputHandler.java and the Mover class is now Controller.java
Added "fog of war" prototype; Updated line of sight values for enemy and added one for player.
Updated fog mechanic. It now recognizes points visited, and where the player is at.
Updated fog. It is now a pseudo-circular area instead of a perfect square.
Fixed the bug where enemies will take two turns for every turn of the player where it should be one is to one.
Fixed bug where fog doesn't reset when a new dungeon other than the first is generated.
Changed the value of the player speed variable lower to make animation smoother.
Added enemy types; Updated input control for changing proficiency; Added imageView and spriteAnimator objects in the enemy class.
Game draws enemy sprites instead of colored squares.
Updated counter for elements and types. Added counter for types.
Updated fireflies count display.
Updated tileset.
Fixed corridors rendering.
Added a simple main menu at the start up of the game with "Start" and "Exit" choices.
Enemy AI update now in a separate method than the main update method.
Added methods for type B and C enemy behaviors.
